expenditures.detail: 44 rows on p9 sum to 24,971.70 against stated 30,865.39; delta 5,893.69. The delta is EXACTLY the set of in-kind items itemized in Schedule A (p7 rows Martine 100.00, Ruth's Chris 200.00, Ahh Sushi 40.00, Cinegrill 50.00, Precision Physical Therapy 300.00 = 690.00, plus all 24 in-kind rows on p8 = 5,203.69) that are NOT carried onto the Schedule B page. Schedule B prints no total and no page subtotal, and its page header reads 'PAGE 8 OF 8' while the Schedule A pages read 'PAGE n OF 12' - the B continuation page is absent from the PDF. Transcribed side is a FLOOR.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: This filing prints NO 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' on any page (the schedules are a spreadsheet attachment on the clerk's form headers) - the page-subtotal gate cannot fire. Substituted structural gates: (a) ruled-row detection on each Schedule A page returns exactly the transcribed row count (p3 30, p4 37, p5 37, p6 37, p7 37, p8 24+total, p9 44), (b) names and amounts are equal in count on every page, (c) the 202 rows sum to the cent to the printed schedule total 77,158.77 on p8.

itemized.notes: Schedule A is a 6-page LANDSCAPE spreadsheet attachment (rotated 90 CCW to read; geometry pointers converted back to poppler-portrait percentages). Dates are printed once per BATCH, not per row: 172 of 202 contribution rows have an empty date cell and are left BLANK (never filled from the heading) with the governing heading named in each row note. The COMPLETE MAILING ADDRESS column is empty for the entire schedule except one clipped line at the very top of p4 that straddles the rule above the Sara Rich row; it is not confidently assignable to a row, so NO donor_city/donor_state was recorded anywhere in this filing (street discarded at read time per privacy). One donor name on p4 is obliterated by the amendment's own highlighter (the Summary Page states 'No change in Amounts - Only change is donor Name which is highlighted') - recorded as '[?]asilee Anderson', confidence low, needs_review. 33 Schedule A rows carry 'In Kind' in the DATE cell; in-kind rows DO count toward the printed total (verified: the 202-row sum equals it exactly). Schedule B repeats only 4 of those in-kind items and its continuation is missing (see recon). Expenditure row 16 is dated '5/31/2000' on a 2007 report - a well-formed filer typo, kept verbatim.
